reason: The README describes a web search plugin that uses Tavily when configured and otherwise falls back to Bing, with configurable result limits and request timeouts.

summaries.zh: 通过 Tavily 或 Bing 提供网页搜索，并支持配置结果数量与请求超时。
summaries.en: Provides web search through Tavily or Bing with configurable result counts and request timeouts.

capabilities: Performs web searches through Tavily when a TAVILY_API_KEY is configured
Falls back to Bing web search without an API key
Makes outbound requests to external search services
Returns a configurable number of search results with timeout settings
